build_articulated_agent_subclass: build a python subclass of ArticulatedAgentInterface that implements update, reset, and reconfigure methods
get_robot_sim_id: get the unique simulation object id for referencing the robot in the scene
get_link_and_joint_names: get a debug string listing all robot link and joint names with their types
set_motor_position: set the position target for a specific joint motor and update the simulation object
capture_agent_state: capture the current articulated agent state including joint forces, velocities, and positions
